unresolved.question: Which code stores the handle qword at [descriptor+0]?
unresolved.reason: the only consumer is 0xC856C0, and 0xC85650, its only caller, has no static reference in any of the scanned forms, so no backward path reaches a store
unresolved.next_static_step: recover the dispatch that reaches 0xC85650, for example by resolving the component method table the host builds at run time

unresolved.question: How is 0xC85650 invoked?
unresolved.reason: zero rel32 call or jmp, zero 8 byte VA pointer, zero RIP-relative materialisation and zero DIR64 slot pointing at the cluster
unresolved.next_static_step: enumerate the vtable or method table of the component object the host populates, then match the 16 byte {vector, descriptor} pair

unresolved.question: What is the layout of the descriptor behind closure+8 beyond offset 0?
unresolved.reason: 0xC856C0 dereferences offset 0 only; no other field of the descriptor is read anywhere in the function
unresolved.next_static_step: recover a second entry point that receives the same descriptor

unresolved.question: Which Nt services do the inline syscalls of 0xC856C0 and the syscalls inside the wrapper functions it calls map to?
unresolved.reason: the service number is produced at run time by shift, XOR, bswap and KUSER_SHARED_DATA mixing inside each wrapper, so it is not a static constant
unresolved.next_static_step: evaluate the mixing chain offline with symbolic KUSER_SHARED_DATA values, as proposed in reverse/adhesive-12-risk-methodology-open-questions.md#10.6

unresolved.question: Are the 16 allocation branches and the 16 transfer branches semantically equivalent encodings of one service, or different services?
unresolved.reason: both stages are selected by an independent RDTSC & 0xF, and the branch bodies differ in argument shape as well as in syscall count
unresolved.next_static_step: normalise every branch to a common Nt level argument schema and compare the schemas instead of the branch counts

unresolved.question: What is the concrete class of the closure and descriptor objects?
unresolved.reason: no MSVC RTTI is present: 0 type descriptor names and 0 Complete Object Locators in .rdata
unresolved.next_static_step: rely on the structural layout recorded in object_model, or correlate with the public CitizenFX component interface without assuming a mapping

unresolved.question: Do the two adjacent jump tables form one 32 way dispatch or two independent 16 way dispatches?
unresolved.reason: 0x2CFB1F8 and 0x2CFB238 are adjacent in .rdata, but each is read by its own RDTSC & 0xF sequence
unresolved.next_static_step: check whether both selector sequences can execute in one invocation and whether the second table is ever reached from a branch that already consumed a first table slot

unresolved.question: Is the value re-read at 0xC86440 guaranteed to be the value loaded at 0xC856F3, or can a called wrapper have replaced [descriptor+0] in between?
unresolved.reason: the allocation stage calls six distinct wrapper functions and executes eight inline syscalls between the two loads; none of them is statically known to write through the descriptor pointer, and the descriptor is a runtime address, so an aliasing store can be neither confirmed nor excluded here
unresolved.next_static_step: propagate the descriptor pointer into each wrapper and test whether any store may alias it, then decide if the two loads form one def-use chain or two independent ones
